project.name: osgi/domains/manifests/manifests-ingress-contract
project.description: The HOST face of the manifests contract — the version pins BOTH realms genuinely consume. ComponentVersions is the single source of truth for the bootstrap-layer component versions: OSGi-side the manifest units read it through the synthesis context; host-side the manifests-cli `versions` bumper reads ComponentVersions.defaults() FLAT to diff each pin against its upstream GitHub release. That dual consumption is why it lives here and not in manifests-contract (type=contract, bundle-wired only, never host-typed). type=dual-realm, like incus-ingress-contract / seed-broker-codec: staged as a bundle OSGi-side AND kept flat host-side, so its exported package legitimately lives in two realms and DUPLICATE_REALM_CLASS exempts it. NOT a seam surface between DOMAINS: producer (the manifests units) and consumer (the manifests bumper) are the SAME domain. Governance (the dual-realm library rule): a type may carry pure logic here IFF it depends only on the JDK + jspecify — ComponentVersions qualifies (a pure String value record, zero imports, manifests-owned, consumed on both sides).
